title: Versioned device configuration/state document from MongoDB change streams (Debezium)
description: Canonical Kafka topic cf.device-state.v1 -> ClickHouse table device_state_versions. Frozen 2026-10-10 (schema_version 1). Key: device_id.

device_id.description: Kafka partition key for every canonical topic

event_time.description: When the fact happened at the source (event-time analytics)

emitted_at.description: When the source system emitted/committed it (not the ingestion time)

version.description: (cluster time seconds << 32) | ord, from the change event source block

full_document.description: true when the event carried the full post-change document; false for patch-only updates

x-null-policy: Absent optional field == explicit null in typed storage; the normalizer counts them separately.
x-notes: With capture.mode=change_streams_update_full the document is looked up after the change, so it can already include later updates (documented race). Patch-only updates leave unknown fields null with full_document=false.
